summary: Sprint 11 testing: Backend APIs (password validation, DLP masking, gear detail, profile) all pass after 2 critical bugs were fixed. Frontend pages load correctly after fixing Navbar 'User is not defined' crash.

bugs_fixed.issue: ReferenceError: User is not defined in Navbar.js
bugs_fixed.root_cause: User icon from lucide-react was used at line 220 but not imported. Caused crash on all authenticated pages (Settings, Coach, AddStudio, etc.)

bugs_fixed.issue: DLP masking bypassed - emails/phones hard-blocked instead of masked
bugs_fixed.root_cause: MODERATION_PATTERNS in utils.py included email and phone patterns which triggered hard-block BEFORE DLP soft-mask could run. Stage 1 block prevented Stage 2 masking.
bugs_fixed.fix: Removed email/phone patterns from MODERATION_PATTERNS in /app/backend/utils.py - these are now handled exclusively by mask_sensitive_content()

features_verified: Gear detail page at /gear/{id} loads correctly (no redirect to home)
Gear detail shows photo gallery, condition badge, price, seller info
RadioRever button visible (data-testid='radio-rever-btn') on Gear page
Studio Marketplace Airbnb split layout: left=cards, right=Leaflet map with price markers
AddStudio /studios/list: address field, geocode button, draggable Leaflet map
Profile Settings /settings: name, bio, genre form loads (login required)
DLP: email in message → [E-POSTA GİZLENDİ], phone → [TELEFON GİZLENDİ]
AI Coach page shows chat UI for users with existing coach_profile
critical_code_review_comments: MODERATION_PATTERNS and mask_sensitive_content had overlapping patterns causing DLP to never trigger - fixed
seed_data_creation: Test users TEST_dlp*, TEST_validpw*, TEST_weakpw* created during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sprint 11 fully tested. 2 critical bugs fixed: (1) Navbar User import, (2) DLP overlapping with hard-block. All 20 features verified. Backend 11/11 tests pass.
